app.name: WordAI
app.tagline: Your data, your device. AuraBrain stores everything locally.

general.sectionDescription: Configure your core workspace environment and interaction patterns.

interfaceMode.label: Interface Mode
interfaceMode.description: Adjust the visual appearance of the editor shell.

autoSave.label: Auto-Save
autoSave.description: Automatically backup your progress to the cloud library as you write.

focusMode.label: Focus Mode
focusMode.description: Automatically hide toolbars and secondary panels when you begin typing.

language.label: Interface Language
language.description: Select the primary language for the editor menus and interface elements.

defaultExportPath.label: Default Export Path
defaultExportPath.description: Default folder when exporting files to Markdown or DOCX.

defaultExportFormat.label: Default Export Format
defaultExportFormat.description: Default file format when exporting documents.

autoSync.label: Auto Sync
autoSync.description: Automatically sync intents to AuraBrain periodically.

aiEngine.sectionDescription: Configure the intelligence that powers your writing — from the agent backbone to the nuance of creative variance.

privacy.sectionDescription: Manage how your data is handled, stored, and transmitted.
privacy.encryptionDescription: Your drafts are never readable by humans. AI processing occurs in a volatile memory environment that wipes upon session termination.

localProcessing.label: Local processing only
localProcessing.description: When enabled, WordAI Editor will process your content only on this device where possible, and avoid sending data to remote services except when strictly required.

aiTraining.label: AI Model Training
aiTraining.description: Anonymized snippets help improve the engine. We never store personal identifiers.

storagePath.label: AuraBrain Storage Location
storagePath.description: The folder path where AuraBrain database is stored on this device.

conflict.title: Intent already exists
conflict.message: This file belongs to Intent "{{intentName}}". Do you want to update that Intent with new content?
